title_hi: AI: नौकरी की बात - क्या होगा?
on_screen: AI: naukri ki baat - kya hoga?
AI: naukri ki baat - kya hoga?
goal:
- AI Indian job market mein impact kar raha hai, especially software developers aur customer support professionals ke liye.
- Google Cloud–National Research Group ki survey (2026) se 56% global manufacturing executives AI agents use karte hain aur 37% over ten AI tools deploy karte hain.
- Deployment – impact gap hai; installing AI software alone productivity nahi badhate.

title_hi: नए ऑपर्च्युनिटीज़, नई स्किल्स - कैसे होगा?
on_screen: Naye opportunity, nayi skills - kaise hoga?
Naye opportunity, nayi skills - kaise hoga?
goal:
- AI machine-learning engineers, prompt designers aur data annotators ke jaise naye career options banata hai.
- India me 2027 तक AI market USD 17 billion ki hogi aur 2024 me approximately 4.2 lakh AI professionals hain.
- World Economic Forum ne 2030 तक 170 million new jobs aur 92 million displaced jobs ki prediction di hai.

title_hi: फाइनली, थे बिग रिवेल - एंसर क्या है?
on_screen: Phainli, the big rivel - ensar kya hai?
Phainli, the big rivel - ensar kya hai?
goal:
- AI not just job losses ka karan hai, lekin augmentation ke opportunities bhi banata hai.
- Raymond & Infosys ke jaise companies automation se impact faced hain, par AI-driven efficiency se skills walon ki wages 56% tak badhi hai.
- India me AI se jobs mein competition hoga, par innovation aur upskilling se naye opportunities bhi banenge.
